panels.title: Journées d'entraînement

targets.queryText:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) AS value
FROM working_sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})

panels.description: Dernière série de travail dans la période et les filtres.

panels.title: Volume par journée, par séance

targets.queryText:
SELECT w.day_ts AS time, s.name AS seance, SUM(w.volume) AS volume
FROM working_sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
GROUP BY w.day_ts, s.name
ORDER BY w.day_ts

panels.title: 1RM estimé (Epley)

panels.description: charge × (1 + reps ÷ 30), meilleure série de travail de la journée. Une estimation, pas un record.

panels.title: Records par exercice

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       s.name AS Séance,
       MAX(w.weight) AS "Charge max",
       ROUND(MAX(w.weight * (1 + w.reps / 30.0)), 1) AS "1RM estimé",
       COUNT(DISTINCT w.day) AS Journées,
       COUNT(*) AS Séries,
       MAX(w.completed_ts) AS Dernière
FROM working_sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
GROUP BY w.seance_slug, w.exercise_slug
ORDER BY "Charge max" DESC
targets.rawQueryText:

       s.name AS Séance,

FROM working_sets w

panels.description: Part de chaque exercice dans le volume de la période.

panels.title: Toutes les séries

targets.queryText:
SELECT w.completed_ts AS Date,
       s.name AS Séance,
       COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       w.reps AS Reps,
       w.weight AS Charge,
       w.volume AS Volume,
       CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN 'échauffement' ELSE 'travail' END AS Type
FROM sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug
  LEFT JOIN exercises e ON e.seance_slug = w.seance_slug AND e.slug = w.exercise_slug
WHERE w.completed_ts BETWEEN $__from / 1000 AND $__to / 1000
  AND w.seance_slug IN (${seance:sqlstring})
  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
ORDER BY w.completed_ts DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT w.completed_ts AS Date,
       s.name AS Séance,
       COALESCE(e.name, w.exercise_slug) AS Exercice,
       w.reps AS Reps,
       w.weight AS Charge,
       w.volume AS Volume,
       CASE WHEN w.is_warmup THEN 'échauffement' ELSE 'travail' END AS Type
FROM sets w
  JOIN seances s ON s.slug = w.seance_slug

  AND w.exercise_slug IN (${exercice:sqlstring})
ORDER BY w.completed_ts DESC
